title: Great, solid TV
review_text: Customer rating: Great, solid TV This is my second Roku TV and this one is just as solid and easy to use as my first one. The picture is clear, good sound, and no issues with apps. The delivery was quick as well. The only thing I would mention has nothing to do with the tv itself, but for those who currently have a Roku tv. For some reason, my remote for the new tv wouldn't "pair" and therefore I couldn't get things set up initially. I even followed all the help guides and contacted the support chat, which was no help. However, somehow and for some reason, my old remote from my past tv ended up working with this one, which was my only saving grace. I'm assuming they're made from the same brand (TCL), even though this one is Roku branded. So heads up for anyone who has a Roku tv already. Otherwise, still a great tv. Not

title: Loved It, But Returned
review_text: Customer rating: Loved It, But Returned Beautiful 50" Flatscreen. Worked perfectly. Dont care for QLED. Too bright. Difficult to get rich deep colored picture, even after setting screen particulars. Picture mainly stayed too bight without depth. Everything worked perfectly, and easily. Very easy to set up. Attached cable box, speaker bar, indoor antenna & LED back lights. The only caveat: was the TV was not the stated size of 50". Measured and compaired to my most perfect, but sadly dead Toshiba flatscreen, that was 49", and larger than this 50" TV. Not happy with the size. Have had it one week, but will return and exchange for the 55" model. Other wise a lovely HDTV. Not

title: Screws not centered
review_text: Customer rating: Screws not centered The screw holes are not centered on the TV. Therefor I cannot put it on my RV wall mount. It needs to be centered, because I have cabinet shelves on top. My last 2 TVs were 50 inches and centered, so the top of the TV didn't touch the shelves. Screws mounts were centered on those. This TV has the screw holes at the bottom. So the top reaches the cabinet shelves. So I can't put it on. This RV TV rack to hook it is designed to be centered on the RV wall. It won't fit on this small bottom self either on its legs. Not happy at all. Not
